title: The chip shows in Tech View and on the phone
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a phone, or a browser window narrowed to 390 pixels wide, signed in to the same account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, line 2 marked No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Switch to the Tech View display.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 2 shows the chip "No Charge · Goodwill" and $0.00 on the phone layout.

Step 2:

  • Line 2 shows the chip in Tech View.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R3: “A no-charge line shows the chip "No Charge · [category]" next to its title on the lines table, in Tech View and on mobile; Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00; Margin shows nothing. Hours, technician, status, approval, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clock-ins, notes, inspections and the story work as on any line. The original work order and line are not shown on the line; they are in the notes, the Audit Log, the report and the hub record.”
  • Story 12, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized. The line menu item, the chip and the $0.00 price follow the line on desktop, Tech View and the mobile app; the dialogs are the existing dialog pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
